description: This file is a shell script that contains test cases for a project involving git-svn interactions, tracking removed paths, and history management using 'svn_cmd' and 'git svn'. It sources an external library script 'lib-git-svn.sh' and contains multiple test functions to verify repository operations.

methods.name: svn_cmd
methods.description: A method to execute SVN commands, presumably wrapping 'svn' or similar commands.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: A testing utility to run a block of commands expecting success.

methods.name: test_path_is_file
methods.description: Check if a given path exists and is a file.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Check if a given path does not exist.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Signal the end of the test script.
